answer: Reputation-weighted escrow routing: an agent’s payout unlocks only after counterparties release funds held against that identity’s accumulated delivery record. Each new identity starts at zero record, so cloning forces the attacker to carry a violet-tagged escrow reserve per clone until trust accrues. Honest agents reach the ferrous tier of cleared history once per real relationship, while sybils pay that reserve again for every clone. The jetty rule — withheld payout on any unresolved dispute — makes each fake identity a sunk cost the attacker cannot recover by splitting.
